## Q. I want to adjust the size of the text and characters

- In OmikujiBot Editor, you can adjust **only the size of the character**.
- **To adjust the overall look of the speech bubble and character, follow these two steps:**
  1. First, **change the character size** in the app.
  2. Then, **adjust the overall scale** in OBS.

### Changing the Character Size (in the app)

- In OmikujiBot Editor, go to **"Items"** and select the **Speech Bubble Item (Character)**.
- Specify the size you want under **"Character Size"**.

### Scaling in OBS (on the display side)

- In the OBS source list, select the **speech bubble (browser source)**.
- **Drag the red frame handles** at the corners and edges of the source to adjust its size.
- Hold the Shift key while dragging to scale freely **without locking the aspect ratio**.
- To move the source, simply **drag it**.
